stage: member B section 2 per-element support summary

definitions.recordable: delivered tool: a line counts as compatible when its fluorescence cross section at the tube voltage is > 0 AND recorded_window_fraction > 0.5; this script reuses the same rule
definitions.excitable_at_voltage: core.line_cs() calls xraylib CS_FluorLine_Kissel_Cascade with the electron energy set to voltage_kV, and xraylib raises for transitions below their shell threshold, so the flag does respect the absorption edge. core.py:226 states it is "necessary excitation availability only, not flux"
definitions.response: detector_efficiency x exit_air_transmission of one line. Per core.detector_efficiency the exit-path terms are the Be window and the Si dead layer only; the Al filter multiplies the PRIMARY beam inside core.source_spectrum, so filter_Al_um never appears in this response and a filter effect on a line must be argued from the excitation side, not here
definitions.no_line_inside_window: every modelled line of that system falls outside the fitted energy window of the profile
definitions.channel: (energy_keV - zero_keV) / gain_keV_channel, the centre channel the delivered binning would place the line in
definitions.principal_line: K = KL3 (K-alpha1), L = L3M5 (L-alpha1); M4/M5 -> N transitions are not in the delivered LINE_NAMES table, so for the M system no principal line is reported and only the recorded energy band and the best-response line are meaningful

tool_notes: the delivered notes block is copied verbatim into every support JSON; see work/profile_support/B_profile_support_P3.json root key "notes"
